title: Iphone app, horizontal scrolling between stories sluggish/frozen
summary: The new (v15) app gets stuck sliding between stories. It’ll stop halfway between the story slide, or it’ll go slow, or it’ll freeze for a moment or 20+ seconds. It’s kind of random on when it how long it’ll freeze. It makes using the app slow, especially when I’m trying to go through a couple hundred news stories in a few minutes. I’ve managed to catch it in a screen recording. Has anyone seen this?

# [Iphone app, horizontal scrolling between stories sliggish/frozen](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/iphone-app-horizontal-scrolling-between-stories-sliggish-frozen/13855)


[problem](https://forum.newsblur.com/c/problem/6)


[tedder42](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/tedder42)


September 26, 2026, 3:51pm 1


The new (v15) app gets stuck sliding between stories. It’ll stop halfway between the story slide, or it’ll go slow, or it’ll freeze for a moment or 20+ seconds. It’s kind of random on when it how long it’ll freeze.


It makes using the app slow, especially when I’m trying to go through a couple hundred news stories in a few minutes.


I’ve managed to catch it in a screen recording.


Has anyone seen this?
